51563435.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to recombinant human galectin-3 carbohydrate-recognition domain expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells assessed as dissociation constant by Nano-ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Thermodynamic Properties of Ligand Bindi: Isothermal titration calorimetry (ITC) experiments were performed at 25 °C with a Nano-ITC instrument (TA Instruments) with a sample volume of 1038 μL, 250 μL syringe, and stirring speed of 170 rpm. The sample cell was loaded with the solution of galectin-3 CRD (20 μM) in 0.1 M Tris-HCl, pH 7.5 buffer, and ligand lactose (1 mM), TDG (2 mM), 14 (0.3 mM), 13, 15 (0.4 mM), and 17 (0.6 mM), in the same buffer as the galectin-3 CRD, were placed in the injection syringe. Titration was performed with 16 injections of 15 μL aliquots with 150s spacing between injections to allow baseline recovery. Data analysis was performed using NanoAnalyze software (TA Instruments). Crystallography data have confirmed one binding site and thus an independent model was chosen as a choice to fit ITC data to determine the dissociation constant (Kd), enthalpy (ΔH), and entropy change (ΔS) for all ligands with galectin-3 CRD.
